name: airline safety card
content_styles: Write like an airline safety card about the topic. A 'brace position', an 'oxygen masks' section, a 'life vest' section, and a 'do not' list. Voice is deadpan, instructional, and absurdly serious about nonsense.
Write like an in-flight safety announcement. A welcome, a 'fasten your seatbelt' note, a 'tray tables up' note, and a 'thank you for flying' closer. Voice is cheerful and robotic.
Write like a pre-flight briefing. A 'welcome aboard', a 'safety features' section, a 'in case of emergency' section, and a 'we hope you enjoy' closer. Voice is calm and slightly ominous.
layouts: Build a safety card: a header, a 'brace position' section, an 'oxygen masks' section, a 'life vest' section, and a 'do not' list. One continuous card with diagrams.
Build a safety announcement: a header, a welcome, a 'fasten your seatbelt' note, a 'tray tables up' note, and a 'thank you' closer. One continuous announcement.
Build a briefing: a header, a 'welcome aboard', a 'safety features' section, an 'in case of emergency' section, and a 'we hope you enjoy' closer. One continuous briefing.
themes: Safety card look: white background, red and blue accents, a clean sans-serif, and a diagram feel. Unified and instructional.
Airline look: navy background, white text, gold accents, and a polished sans-serif. Unified and premium.
Retro airline look: muted colors, a vintage font, and a nostalgic feel. Unified and retro.
visual_style: VISUAL: instructional diagram. White background, red/blue accents, diagram frames, a brace-position illustration, and a clean instructional sans-serif.
